description: Routines: small steps that repeat on fixed weekdays, e.g. "talk with one person on Reddit", or that count up to a number a week, e.g. "talk to 5 people a week", each with an optional bad-day minimum. The server adds them to each matching day's plan, so every device and agent sees the same checks. With no routines yet, returns ready-made starters for the aim's area to offer as they are.
name: get_routines
title: Get routines
